name: Decay [HALF WALLS]
desc:
Wake up on a hostile island with nothing but a rock and a torch.
Gather resources, craft gear, build your base, and defend it from other players.

A Rust-inspired survival experience on Roblox.

CONTROLS
TAB - Inventory
Q - Crafting
G - Map
1-6 - Hotbar slots
CTRL + Click - Quick move
